title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for established conditions.

History of Present Illness
The patient presents for follow-up management of their type 2 diabetes. They report adherence to a diet and exercise regimen, stating their type 2 diabetes is currently diet controlled. The patient also has chronic kidney disease stage 4. Reviewing the etiology, the provider explicitly stated that the CKD stage 4 is unrelated to diabetes.

Medication List
[List of current medications provided by the patient]

Exam
Vitals: Stable. Cardiovascular exam reveals regular rate and rhythm. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Abdomen is soft and non-tender.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes: Managed with diet and exercise; currently diet controlled.
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4: Monitoring continues; the provider confirms this condition is not due to diabetes.

Plan
Continue current diet and exercise plan for T2DM. Follow up with primary care in three months. Will reassess kidney function parameters at that time.
explanations: The provider states the CKD is not due to diabetes, so the presumed link does not apply: code diabetes without complications and CKD separately.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.

distractors.why: The 'with' presumption is overridden when the provider documents another cause or no link.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
